invariants.name: assert_no_domain_write
invariants.sql:
SELECT
            (SELECT count(*) FROM tasks       WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND created_at >= $2)::int AS tasks,
            (SELECT count(*) FROM reminders   WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND created_at >= $2)::int AS reminders,
            (SELECT count(*) FROM memory_items WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND (idempotency_key LIKE $3 OR source_message_id=$4 OR created_at >= $2))::int AS memory_items
